article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Felix Kossaras scored 14 points off the bench in his opener Monday as George Washington defeated Navy 91-39. Kossaras shot 4 for 6 from beyond the arc for the Revolutionaries. Ryder Frost scored 14 points, shooting 4 for 9 (2 for 6 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line. Promis N’Landu went 6 for 7 from the field to finish with 14 points. David Burnett led the Midshipmen with 11 points and seven rebounds. Navy also got eight points from Cam Cole. Drew Timmons added four points. George Washington took the lead with 19:48 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Kossaras led his team in scoring with eight points in the first half to help put the Revolutionaries up 44-24 at the break. George Washington extended its lead to 59-24 during the second half, fueled by a 15-0 scoring run. Frost scored a team-high 11 points in the second half as George Washington closed out the win. Up next George Washington plays Saturday against Hampton at home, and Navy hosts Delaware State on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
